def _get_instance(model, pk):
    try:
        return model.objects.get(pk=pk)
    except model.DoesNotExist:
        raise GraphQLError(f"{model.__name__} with id {pk} does not exist.") from None


def _save_instance(instance, data, many_to_many):
    for key, value in data.items():
        if key not in many_to_many:
            setattr(instance, key, value)
    # Only validate what the caller supplied: values the model fills in itself
    # (for example an empty JSON default) would otherwise fail the blank check.
    exclude = [
        field.name
        for field in instance._meta.fields
        if field.name not in data and field.attname not in data
    ]
    try:
        instance.full_clean(exclude=exclude)
    except ValidationError as error:
        raise GraphQLError("; ".join(error.messages)) from error
    instance.save()
    for key, name in many_to_many.items():
        if data.get(key) is not None:
            getattr(instance, name).set(data[key])
    return instance

class Query(graphene.ObjectType):
    blog_user = graphene.Field(BlogUserType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    blog_user_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(BlogUserType), required=True)
    blog_category = graphene.Field(BlogCategoryType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    blog_category_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(BlogCategoryType), required=True)
    blog_tag = graphene.Field(BlogTagType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    blog_tag_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(BlogTagType), required=True)
    blog_post = graphene.Field(BlogPostType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    blog_post_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(BlogPostType), required=True)
    blog_profile = graphene.Field(BlogProfileType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    blog_profile_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(BlogProfileType), required=True)

    def resolve_blog_user(root, info, id):
        return BlogUser.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_blog_user_list(root, info):
        return BlogUser.objects.all()

    def resolve_blog_category(root, info, id):
        return BlogCategory.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_blog_category_list(root, info):
        return BlogCategory.objects.all()

    def resolve_blog_tag(root, info, id):
        return BlogTag.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_blog_tag_list(root, info):
        return BlogTag.objects.all()

    def resolve_blog_post(root, info, id):
        return BlogPost.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_blog_post_list(root, info):
        return BlogPost.objects.all()

    def resolve_blog_profile(root, info, id):
        return BlogProfile.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_blog_profile_list(root, info):
        return BlogProfile.objects.all()
